headline: Approved payments for audit work, training, newspaper ad, insurance fee, and a donation.
summary: The board approved several payments, including $7,050.00 to CBIZ CPA's P.C. for audit work, $8,4000.00 for training sessions by Manette Donovan Esq, up to $12,000.00 for staff to attend the NEAHMA Maintenance Expo, $480.00 to Advocate Newspapers, Inc., and up to $10,000.00 to the GIC for an administrative fee. The board also approved a $100.00 donation to the Malden High School Alumni Association. All votes were unanimous.
decisions: Approved payment of $7,050.00 to CBIZ CPA's P.C. for 2nd payment on the FY2025 audit, unanimous.
Approved Manette Donovan Esq to conduct two training sessions on Fair Housing and CORI, with payment up to $8,4000.00, unanimous.
Approved up to twelve MHA Maintenance staff to attend the NEAHMA Maintenance Expo at a total cost of up to $12,000.00, unanimous.
Approved payment of $480.00 to Advocate Newspapers, Inc. for a bid advertisement, unanimous.
Approved payment up to $10,000.00 to the GIC for the FY2025 Administrative Fee, unanimous.
Approved a $100.00 donation to the Malden High School Alumni Association, unanimous.

02/24/26

# THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE MALDEN HOUSING AUTHORITY

The regular meeting of the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) was held on February 24, 2026, at 8:30 AM at the office of the Authority, 630 Salem Street, Malden, MA 02148. All votes are by roll call with remote Commissioners.

**COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING:** William P. Hurley and Karin H. Nystrom

**COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING REMOTELY:** Frank M. Molis and Joan M. Chiasson

**COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:** Emmanual Marsh

**MHA STAFF:** Stephen G. Finn and Barbara A. Hooley

**MHA STAFF ATTENDING REMOTELY:** Thomas P. Callaghan

## 1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 2-10-26

The Board reviewed the minutes of the 2-10-26 meeting.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the 2-10-26 meeting minutes.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

## 2. APPROVAL OF THE BILLS AND SIGNING OF CHECKS None

## 3. FINANCIAL MATTERS

### A. CBIZ CPA'S P.C.--Invoice

The Board analyzed an invoice dated 2-16-26 in the amount of $7,050.00 from CBIZ CPA's P.C. for 2nd payment for work completed on MHA's FY2025 audit with cost paid as allocated by the Finance Director.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Frank M. Molis and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize payment in the amount of $7,050.00 from CBIZ CPA's P.C. for 2nd payment for work completed on the FY2025 audit with cost paid as allocated by the Finance Director.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### B. MANETTE DONOVAN Esq--Training Sessions (2)

The Board considered a request for approval and authorization for Manette Donovan Esq to conduct two (2) training sessions consisting of Fair Housing and CORI (Criminal Offender Record Offender Information), together of approval of payment up to $8,4000.00 with cost paid as allocated by the Finance Director.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson and seconded by Frank M. Molis, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize Manette Donovan Esq to conduct two (2) training sessions as detailed above, together with approval of payment up to $8,4000.00 with cost paid as allocated by the Finance Director.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### C. NEW ENGLAND AFFORDABLE HOUSING MANAGEMENT ASSOCIATION (NEAHMA)--Maintenance Expo

The Board examined a request for approval and authorization for up to twelve (12) MHA Maintenance staff to attend the NEAHMA Maintenance Exposition being held on 4/29/26 at Gilette Stadium. The staff will require a hotel accommodation for the evening before the event, registration fees, meals, mileage reimbursement and approval to spend up to $12,000.00 if all expected Maintenance staff attend with cost as allocated by the Finance Director. The Executive Director noted that the amount is an estimate and staff may not be able to attend due to scheduling conflicts and will keep the Board updated of the status of this event.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize up to twelve (12) MHA's Maintenance staff to attend the NEAHMA Maintenance Expo at a total cost of up to $12,000.00 as detailed above with cost as determined by the Finance Director.

Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Nays: None

### D. THE ADVOCATE NEWSPAPERS, INC (MALDEN ADVOCATE)--Invoice

The Board studied an invoice dated 2/20/2026 in the amount of $480.00 from Advocate Newspapers, Inc. for a published MHA bid advertisement for the upcoming Springdale Development Paving Project in the (2/20/26) edition with cost to be paid by the State through CapHub.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Frank M. Molis, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize payment in the amount of $480.00 to Advocate Newspapers, Inc. as detailed above with cost to be paid by the State through CapHub.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis and Karin Nystrom

Nays: None

### E. MASSACHUSETTS GROUP INSURANCE COMMISSION (GIC)--Invoice

The Board evaluated a request for approval of payment up to $10,000.00 to the GIC for the FY2025 Administrative Fee invoice with cost as allocated by the Finance Director. The Executive Director noted that the Board will be informed of actual amount of invoice once received.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson and seconded by Frank M. Molis, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize payment in the amount up to $10,000. to the GIC for the yearly FY2025 Administrative Fee.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis and Karin Nystrom

Nays: None

## 4. POLICIES AND CONTRACTS None

## 5. REVIEW OF CHARITABLE REQUESTS

The Board perused a request from the Malden High School Alumni Association for a donation for Hall of Fame Banquet being held on May 1, 2026.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize donation in the amount of $100.00 to the Malden High School Alumni Association with cost paid by the COCC.

Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis and Karin Nystrom

Nays: None

## 6. CORRESPONDENCE, PUBLICATIONS AND COMMUNICATIONS:

## 9. OPEN DISCUSSION None

## ADJOURNMENT

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Frank M. Molis, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To Adjourn

Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom

Adjourned at 9:00AM

Joan M. Chiasson, Secretary
